acceptance_oracle: Saving an existing search profile records exactly one generic, empty-payload profile SETTING_CHANGED event when effective normalized values change. Initial creation and unchanged repeat saves emit none. A connected Activity reload displays the event without revealing saved criteria and another profile cannot read it.

red_observation.result: FAIL as expected before implementation: expected one new SETTING_CHANGED event after changing an existing search profile; observed zero. The connected browser pause-flow regression also failed because no event was added to the profile timeline.

implementation: save_search_profile compares the existing owner, name, enabled flag, normalized criteria, and source IDs with the normalized update inside the current transaction.
Effective updates append an empty-payload SETTING_CHANGED event for the affected profile owner or owners in the same transaction; initial and unchanged saves do not.
The connected Sources UI pause action is exercised against a synthetic profile, and Activity history is checked after browser reload for value-free display and profile isolation.
